{{Quote|Who the-- UNGGGG!!|The three-eyed bounty hunter falls under swooper attack|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 6">[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref>}}
A Gran '''bounty hunter''' teamed up with a group of fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in late [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] in a last-ditch attempt to steal away the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] before Fett could deliver Solo to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and collect the corresponding [[Bounty/Legends|reward]]. Outside of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], the three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] hunter and Bossk's troupe clashed with [[Gizz's Gang|Jabba's swoop gang]], sent by Jabba himself to steal the frozen Solo away from Fett so the Hutt would not have to pay Fett's hefty sum, and defeated the [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]]. However, Fett duped his assailants into believing he was loading Solo into the palace aboard a [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]], while he secretly sneaked into the palace unmolested.
